Section 1 delegates 'the authority vested in the President by section 271 of title 10'. Former 10 U.S.C. 271 no longer exists under that number; the held Code note prints the order under 10 U.S.C. 10149 with the editorial bracket [see 10149]. The text of 10 U.S.C. 10149 as in force on 2026-10-14, and the restatement act showing that the former section 271 authority to prescribe screening regulations passed to it, are not held (jobs/current-law/output/usc-sections holds no title 10 section 271 or 10149 text). Per the producer rule for orders whose authority statute was renumbered or repealed, a YES claim is blocked until that statute text is held.

Otherwise the order reads as in force: Section 2 (revoking EO 10651) took effect on issuance; EO 11382 section 13 and EO 13286 section 67 changed only the Coast Guard officer named; no revocation held; DoD rule 64 FR 72027 (1999) cites 10 U.S.C. 10149 and EO 11190 together.
